Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) to determine the DDX5 interactome. Acquisition is DDA based on the use of a Q-Exactive Plus and Mascot search. Quantification is performed via spectral counting (LFQ).

scope: The interactome of DDX5 in mock- and SINV-infected cells was determined by mass spectrometry.
We immunoprecipitated DDX5 from mock and SINV-infected HCT116 cells at a MOI of 0.1 for 24 h and eluates were analysed by liquid chromatography coupled to tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS).

Lysates were incubated over night at 4 °C with 40 µL of Dynabeads protein G beads conjugated with 2 µg rabbit anti-DDX5 antibody (ab21696; Abcam), or rabbit anti-DDX17 antibody (19910-1-AP, Proteintech) or 2 µg rabbit IgG antibody (2729; Cell Signaling Technology).

Proteins eluted from the beads were washed with 2 sequential overnight precipitations with glacial 0.1 M ammonium acetate in 100% methanol (5 volumes) followed by 3 washes with glacial 0.1 M ammonium acetate in 80% methanol.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically analyzed the DDX5 interactome using antibody-based immunoprecipitation (affinity purification) from cell lysates. While the text discusses the re-localization of DDX5 to the cytoplasm, the MS material itself was the purified complex eluted from beads, not a pre-fractionated subcellular lysate.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment uses DDA (Q-Exactive Plus) and spectral counting (SpC) for quantification, which is a label-free approach. While SpC is not strictly LFQ-intensity based, it is the standard label-free quantification method for affinity purification (AP-MS) datasets.

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment is explicitly described as an interactome analysis using immunoprecipitation (IP) of DDX5 and IgG controls.

differential: Differential expression tests were performed using a negative binomial regression model.
criteria were used to define differentially expressed proteins: an adjusted P-value < 0.05, a minimum of 5 SpC in the most abundant condition, and a minimum absolute Log2 fold change of 1.
Significantly enriched proteins were determined as having an FDR < 1%, at least 5 spectral counts in the most abundant condition, a fold change of at least 2 and an adjusted p-value lower than 0.05.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The study uses spectral counting (SpC) for quantification of the DDX5 interactome. The differential analysis compares DDX5-IP vs IgG-IP in both mock and SINV-infected conditions.
